method: same VLM checklist, each final image evaluated independently, uncertain counted false

per_constraint.criterion: A golden retriever is present and recognizable.

baseline.reason: A golden retriever is clearly visible on the left side of the image, identifiable by its light brown fur and distinct shape.

draftdag.reason: A golden retriever is clearly visible running towards the red ball.

per_constraint.criterion: A red tennis ball is present.

baseline.reason: A red tennis ball is present in the air, being sprayed by the water arc from the hose.

draftdag.reason: A red tennis ball is present on the ground near the dogs.

baseline.reason: A woman wearing a floral dress and a hat is visibly present in the center of the image.

draftdag.reason: A woman in a floral dress and hat is present, standing next to the bicycle.

per_constraint.criterion: The woman visibly adjusts or holds the garden hose nozzle.

baseline.reason: The woman is holding the garden hose nozzle with both hands and appears to be adjusting or directing the water spray.

draftdag.reason: The woman is adjusting the bicycle basket, not a garden hose.

per_constraint.criterion: The hose water forms a curved arc.

baseline.reason: The water from the hose forms a clear curved arc leading towards the red ball.

draftdag.reason: There is no visible water arc from a hose in the image.

per_constraint.criterion: A distinct terrier is visibly digging at the oak base.

baseline.reason: There is no distinct terrier visible digging at the base of the oak tree; only a smaller dog is near the tree.

draftdag.reason: No distinct terrier is visibly digging at the oak base.

per_constraint.criterion: A bicycle leans against the fence.

baseline.reason: A bicycle is leaning against a fence in the background, to the left of the woman.

draftdag.reason: A bicycle leans against the wooden fence in the background.

per_constraint.criterion: The bicycle has a wicker basket containing wilted daisies.

baseline.reason: While there is a basket on the bicycle, it is not clearly identifiable as wicker, nor does it visibly contain wilted daisies.

draftdag.reason: The bicycle has a wicker basket containing flowers.

per_constraint.criterion: A pickup truck is present near the oak.

baseline.reason: A dark-colored vehicle, resembling a pickup truck, is parked under the oak tree on the right side of the image.

draftdag.reason: A pickup truck is visible near the oak tree.

per_constraint.criterion: The cat is visibly perched on the truck hood, not beside it.

baseline.reason: A cat is visibly perched on the hood of the truck, not beside it.

draftdag.reason: The cat is visibly perched on the truck hood.

per_constraint.criterion: A distant clock tower is visible.

baseline.reason: A distant clock tower is visible in the background on the left side of the image.

draftdag.reason: A distant clock tower is visible in the background.

per_constraint.criterion: A drone is visible above the scene.

baseline.reason: A drone is visible flying in the sky above the scene.

draftdag.reason: A drone is visible flying above the scene.

per_constraint.criterion: A swarm of ladybugs is visible.

baseline.reason: A swarm of small red objects, resembling ladybugs, is visible forming a line in the air.

draftdag.reason: A swarm of ladybugs is visible in the air.

per_constraint.criterion: The ladybugs visibly form a continuous bridge or chain.

baseline.reason: The ladybugs are visibly connected in a continuous chain-like formation.

draftdag.reason: The ladybugs are visibly forming a continuous bridge or chain.

per_constraint.criterion: That ladybug bridge visibly runs from a low oak branch toward the red tennis ball.

baseline.reason: The ladybug bridge starts from a low branch of the oak tree and extends towards the red tennis ball in the air.

draftdag.reason: The ladybug bridge runs from a low oak branch toward the red tennis ball.

limitations: One prompt, one stochastic generation per arm, one VLM evaluation per image; not a statistical result.
VLM judgments may be wrong; inspect image and reasons manually.
DAG uses extra LLM calls and hand-chosen coordinates; any gain is not attributable solely to DAG structure.
The final Qwen img2img stage redraws the whole canvas and may remove draft constraints.
